boundary: resources/help and resources/packages/**/*.maxhelp; core help/**/*.maxpat support files

full_help_conformance.meaning: No installed help file has been run end-to-end in Ultra or compared against Max by this inventory

coverage.note: Filenames, tokens, parsed graphs and UI resemblance do not certify object behavior. Aliases and namespaces remain distinct.

execution_policy: Inventory first. No file is admitted automatically; scripts, attributes, branches, dependencies, clocks and expected outputs need explicit case contracts.
